lines.en: label day140:
scene mollyarrives1
: ...and so you’ll be expected to turn in the transfer paperwork at the end of the day today, and again when the second student arrives.
: Do you understand, Sensei?
: Can’t you just fill out the paperwork for me? I’m tired and don’t even want to be here today.
As you can see, Makoto is briefing me on what I’m supposed to do both before and after the first new girl arrives.
It doesn’t sound like a load of extra work, but it does sound like work in general, and I don’t remember signing up for anything like that.
scene mollyarrives2
: Don’t give me that crap, Sensei. Especially after I’ve done virtually everything for you.
: All you need to do is sign your name and agree to take on responsibility for her.
: But what if she’s another Yumi? Two delinquents in one class is too many.
: In fact, one delinquent is too many. Can I trade in Yumi for someone else?
: Sana is easy to deal with. Can I get another one of her?
scene mollyarrives3
: Actually, it’s funny you mention that. I was just thinking on the way to[school] this morning that Yumi’s gotten significantly better as of late.
: Better in what way? All she does is insult me and skip[school].
: Well, that’s true. But at least her grades are improving when she does decide to show up.
: You haven’t been actually tutoring her, have you?
Well...I guess there was that one time on the roof, but...I can’t think of any other time.
Either way, I’m not going to let Makoto know that.
I’ve felt myself slowly slipping to her bad side, so any chance I get to make myself look good, I will gladly take.
: Actually, my dear Makoto, I have been tutoring Yumi. That’s why I’ve been so tired lately.
scene mollyarrives4
: Huh...Is it wrong that my initial instinct is to call you a liar? I seem to have a harder time believing that than I should.
: Me? A liar? How dare you.
: I’ll have you know I graduated top of my class in the Navy Seals, and I’ve been involved in numerous secret raids on-
scene mollyarrives5
: Sensei...This is no time for joking around.
: Class is about to start and the transfer student should be showing up at any moment.
: Why did you say ‘transfer’ so strangely right there? Are you upset about this or something?
scene mollyarrives6
: Hmm...Upset isn’t the right word.
: I just don’t see the point in it if she’s not a real transfer. She’s just moving over from some other class.
: It’s already annoying enough having to compete with nine other girls, so...
: What was that last part? You started whispering and I couldn’t really hear you.
scene mollyarrives7
: Oh, that was nothing. Just talking to myself.
: Now if you’ll excuse me, I’d like to sit down before you take attendance so as to not risk any imperfect marks on my record.
scene mollyarrives8
Makoto vanishes into the classroom and I can hear the volume of the rest of the class go down a few notches once she does.
It’s hard for me to say how everyone else sees Makoto from their perspective, but it seems to me that, at the very least, she’s respected.
Or feared.
But either way, she’s able to change the mood of the room...And that’s always an impressive feat.
I sigh to myself and straighten out my blazer, getting ready to walk into the class.
But just as I’m about to open the door, I hear a set of quickened footsteps come to a sudden halt behind me.
: So...this is the place where wishes come true...
scene mollyarrives9
I turn around to find who I imagine is the transfer student.
It’s strange. Makoto says this girl isn’t a real transfer, but she definitely looks like one.
At the very least, she most certainly isn’t Japanese.
: State your name.
: Molly MacCormack. Reporting for duty, sir.
: And where are you from, Molly?
: Right down the hall, sir. Ms. Watabe’s class.
: No, I meant what country you’re from. You don’t look Japanese.
: Ireland, sir. The Emerald Isle. I’ve come to serve you in any way I can.
: Please don’t say things like that to me. I’ll twist them around in my head until they become something they most definitely are not.
: Hmm...Interesting. Interesting.
: What’s interesting?
: The fire burning in your eyes.
: Are you perhaps interested in [younger_girls]?
She’s too perceptive. She must be eliminated.
: Are you sure you should be asking your new teacher something like that?
: I am not, sir. I will remain in-line like a good soldier.
: Please forgive me. I’m often told that I lack a filter and say things that people from your country normally keep to themselves.
: That...might become problematic in some cases. But I guess it could be fun in a weird sort of way.
: What was that whole thing about this being the place where wishes come true, though?
: It’s from an anime, sir.
: So you’re the type that watches anime?
: I love anime, sir. I would give my life for it.
: Molly.
: Yes, I'm Molly.
: Why was it you moved to Japan again?
: To serve you as my new master, sir.
: That sounds great and all, but what is the real reason?
: It is my dream to become the lead heroine of a harem, sir.
: I am prepared to put my body and soul on the line in pursuit of a love worth dying for.
: ...Exactly how much anime do you watch, Molly?
: Enough to ruin real-life relationships.
: I figured as much...
scene mollyarrives10
: Yeaaaah...I don’t really blame you. Hahaha...
: I can go overboard pretty easily. But I’ll try to keep it to myself in class so I don’t mess anything up for you.
: Oh, you don’t need to worry about something like that.
scene mollyarrives11r
: Hm? What do you mean?
: I don’t really take the same approach to teaching as most other people.
: So is this one of those like, free-form learning thingamajigs?
: I don’t really know what that means, but sure. We can go with that.
scene mollyarrives12r
: So it’s cool if I be weird in class?! Really?!
: Uh...Well, yeah. I guess so.
: I’m starting to think everyone in class is kind of weird in their own way anyway.
scene mollyarrives13r
: This is a wonderful day.
: I can tell by how much your eyes are sparkling.
: Has Molly MacCormack, a cute foreigner all alone in a strange land, finally found the harem she is destined to lead?!
: Find out next week on...
scene mollyarrives10
: Um...Do you think you could help me come up with a cool anime title? I’ve got nothing right now.
: Just go introduce yourself and we’ll think of something later.
scene mollyarrives9
: Sir, yes sir!
scene black
I open the door for Molly and allow her to walk in before me.
But instead of walking up to the front of the class and introducing herself, she wanders right over to Rin’s desk...
scene mollyarrives11
: Huh? Molly?
: What are you doing here?
: To think...my arch nemesis would be here of all places...
scene mollyarrives12
: Wait. Molly, stop it.
: What are you doing?
: Just when I was beginning to think this new life would be easy...
scene mollyarrives13
: Just when I thought I had a chance to thrive!
scene mollyarrives14
: Oh dear god, no.
: Woah! Does this mean Molly is going to be in our class now?!
: Please no. Anything but that.
: What’s wrong with Molly? I think she's fun.
: I’ll never have another peaceful morning again. That’s what.
: Oh stop. You’re just still mad about her calling you a nerd, aren’t you?
scene mollyarrives15
: I’m not a nerd.
scene mollyarrives13
: Molly, please. Don’t do this right now. I’m literally begging you.
scene mollyarrives16
: Rin, do you know this girl?
: No! I don’t! I’ve never even seen her before! I swear!
scene mollyarrives17
: You dare look upon ME and feign ignorance?!
: How can you call yourself the commander of the undead with a backbone so weak?
scene mollyarrives18
: AHHHHH! KILL ME NOW!
: Tch-
: You should be ashamed. Turning your back on the work you’ve accomplished. The battles you’ve fought!
: Battles?...
: WHY ARE YOU DOING THIS TO ME?!
: Me? Pfft. I’m not doing anything.
scene mollyarrives19
: You did this to yourself...
scene black
Molly leaves Rin’s desk and Rin immediately buries her head in her hands, hiding her embarrassment from everyone.
The transfer student, on the other hand...
scene mollyarrives20
: Greetings, fellow students! It is I...the gem of the Emerald Isle, Molly MacCormack, herself!
: And I am here to claim what is rightfully mine!
: I have traveled across the land, searching far and wide...
: Woo!~ Go Molly!~
scene mollyarrives21
: For you see, new-classmates...No, new FRIENDS! I’m a lovely [young]lass who was born with a mission.
: And as the man you all call “Sensei” standing right next to me has agreed to be my new master-
scene mollyarrives22
: Wait, what?
: Since he has AGREED to be my new MASTER, I will now begin my journey.
: But not just as a friend...and NOT just as a classmate...but as an adversary.
scene mollyarrives23
: And if ANYONE plans on taking me down...You will need to go through my master first.
: Molly, I don’t think I ever agreed to-
scene mollyarrives24
: It’s been a pleasure meeting you all.
: And thank you, Sensei, for allowing me to be a part of your class.
scene mollyarrives25
Scattered, awkward applause fills the classroom but I’m pretty sure it’s just Ami, Miku, and Futaba.
Everyone else remains silent and watches as Molly takes her seat...right in the front of class.
Just when I was beginning to settle into my new, calm life as a teacher, someone like her shows up and sits as close to me as possible.
And now I can’t help but think of all the chaos she’s going to cause for not only myself...
But for Rin, who is still crying out of embarrassment in the corner of the classroom.
scene black
